segments.text: Lesson 15
segments.translation: 第15课

segments.text: Secrecy in industry
segments.translation: 行业保密

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: Why is secrecy particularly important in the chemical industries?
segments.translation: 为什么保密在化学工业中特别重要？

segments.text: Two factors weigh heavily against the effectiveness of scientific research in industry.
segments.translation: 有两个因素严重影响了工业科研的有效性。

segments.text: One is the general atmosphere of secrecy in which it is carried out,
segments.translation: 一个是秘密进行的一般气氛，

segments.text: the other the lack of freedom of the individual research worker.
segments.translation: 另一方面是个别研究工作者缺乏自由。

segments.text: In so far as any inquiry is a secret one,
segments.translation: 只要任何查询都是秘密的，

segments.text: it naturally limits all those engaged in carrying it out from effective contact with their fellow scientists either in other countries or in universities,
segments.translation: 它自然会限制所有从事这项工作的人与其他国家或大学的科学家同行进行有效的联系，

segments.text: or even, often enough, in other departments of the same firm.
segments.translation: 甚至经常在同一家公司的其他部门工作。

segments.text: The degree of secrecy naturally varies considerably.
segments.translation: 保密程度自然会有很大差异。

segments.text: Some of the bigger firms are engaged in researches which are of such general and fundamental nature
segments.translation: 一些较大的公司正在从事具有一般性和基本性质的研究

segments.text: that it is a positive advantage to them not to keep them secret.
segments.translation: 对他们来说，不保守秘密是一个积极的优势。

segments.text: Yet a great many processes depending on such research are sought for with complete secrecy until the stage at which patents can be taken out.
segments.translation: 然而，在专利可以被取消的阶段之前，需要完全保密地寻求许多取决于此类研究的流程。

segments.text: Even more processes are never patented at all but kept as secret processes.
segments.translation: 更多的工艺过程根本就不会取得专利权，而是作为秘方保存着。

segments.text: This applies particularly to chemical industries,
segments.translation: 这尤其适用于化工行业，

segments.text: where chance discoveries play a much larger part than they do in physical and mechanical industries.
segments.translation: 其中偶然发现的作用比物理和机械行业要大得多。

segments.text: Sometimes the secrecy goes to such an extent that the whole nature of the research cannot be mentioned.
segments.translation: 有时，保密的程度如此之高，以至于无法提及研究的整个性质。

segments.text: Many firms, for instance have great difficulty in obtaining technical or scientific books from libraries
segments.translation: 例如，许多公司很难从图书馆获得技术或科学书籍

segments.text: because they are unwilling to have their names entered as having taken out such and such a book,
segments.translation: 因为他们不愿意输入他们的名字，因为他们已经拿出了这样或那样的书，

segments.text: for fear the agents of other firms should be able to trace the kind of research they are likely to be undertaking.
segments.translation: 因为担心其他公司的代理商应该能够追踪他们可能进行的研究类型。
